summary: Iter117 tested the REAL printer-mode code in frontend/src/lib/ktp-printer.js, not a fake WS client. Context A was a simulated KT-V520: UA 'Android 11; V520', a window.ReactNativeWebView stub that records postMessage calls, and ktp_device_token/ktp_device_name in localStorage from POST /api/kiosk/printers/register. App.js startPrinterMode connected the WS as role printer. Context B was Anita's phone kiosk (PIN 4321, 390x844). (1) KASGELD: B saved an 'Opname' mutation of SRD 17. A received REMOTE_PRINT (kasgeld_id plus url /api/kiosk/kasgeld/{id}/receipt.png) and posted one PRINT_RECEIPT to the bridge with printer 'kt-v520', remote:true, the matching job_id, lines ['SuriRent N.V.', ..., 'KASGELD BON', ...] and the absolute url. A then sent REMOTE_PRINT_DONE ok:true. B showed the green toast 'Bon geprint op TEST KTP iter117 REAL', and kasgeld-print-ktp shows the circle-check. (2) PAYMENT regression (HUIS 2C history modal, history-print-ktp-{id}): A printed lines 'KWITANTIE Nr D-KW-00106' with the print.html url and acked. history-print-status shows 'Geprint op TEST KTP iter117 REAL' and the green toast appeared. (3) FINANCIAL (voice modal, history-print-fin -> history-print-ktp-fin): A received REMOTE_PRINT with tenant_id and url, printed 'FINANCIEEL OVERZICHT' lines and acked. voice-modal-print-status shows 'Geprint op TEST KTP iter117 REAL' and the green toast appeared. Each job produced exactly 1 bridge message, so nothing printed twice. Backend pytest 4/4 passed: offline printer -> 409, kasgeld REMOTE_PRINT over a real WS carries url + KASGELD BON lines, receipt.png returns 200 image/png, financial REMOTE_PRINT carries url + FINANCIEEL OVERZICHT lines.
action_items: LOW (optional): handleRemotePrint sends REMOTE_PRINT_DONE ok:true right after bridge.postMessage. That only confirms the message was handed to the APK, not that KTPsdk actually printed. Consider having the APK post back a print result (e.g. window.onKtpPrintResult(job_id, ok, error)) and ack only then, so paper/print errors on the device reach the employee.

LOW (optional): if a REMOTE_PRINT ever arrives with no payment_id and empty data.lines, ws.onmessage silently ignores it and the sender only sees 'Geen antwoord' after 20s. Consider acking ok:false with 'Geen bon-regels' instead.
critical_code_review_comments: The fix is correct. ws.onmessage now accepts payment_id OR data.lines.length. handleRemotePrint uses msg.url (made absolute with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) for non-payment jobs, and apkPrintMessage puts printer 'kt-v520' + lines on the message because data.printer is forced to 'kt-v520'.
Backend kasgeld (server.py ~15451) and financial (~11984) REMOTE_PRINT now include url. The printer forward() relays only events whose target matches this printer, which is correct.
For kasgeld/financial acks, REMOTE_PRINT_DONE carries payment_id undefined, so the backend's pay_id is '' and no print_log upsert happens. That is correct and intended.
In the first run, context A opened /api/kiosk/ws twice (likely a reconnect). Only one REMOTE_PRINT and one bridge message per job were observed, so there is no duplicate printing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (kasgeld, payment, financial all printed via the real printer-mode code and acked; green toasts shown)
